about.title: Hollister Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Hollister sits along corridors that carry a steady mix of local and through traffic — 4th Street, San Felipe Road, Rt 25, and San Benito Street all show up regularly in San Benito County's collision records, with recent reporting showing 104 injury collisions and 144 people hurt in a single year. Saturday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. tend to see more reported crashes, likely tied to weekend errands and travel through town. Whatever road you were on, the days right after a crash matter: photos fade from memory, vehicle damage gets repaired, and insurance adjusters start building their file quickly. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we simply connect injured Hollister residents with an independent personal injury attorney, free of charge, so you can get guidance before talking further with any insurance company. There's no obligation to move forward, and no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but claims against a government entity — say, a road maintained by the county — can require notice in as little as six months.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning even if you're found partly responsible, you can still recover damages reduced by your share of fault — but insurers often try to inflate that share early on.

items.title: Recorded Statements Can Be Used Against You
items.desc: There's no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in a standard California car accident case, but a hasty recorded statement to the other driver's insurer can be used to minimize what you're owed later.

items.question: I was hurt in a crash near San Felipe Road — do I have to accept the insurance adjuster's first call?
items.answer: No. You're not required to give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company, and it's often better not to until you've spoken with an attorney. Anything you say can be used to shift blame or downplay your injuries. LawProactive can connect you with an independent attorney before you respond.

items.question: What if the crash happened on a road maintained by San Benito County or the city?
items.answer: Claims involving government-maintained roads follow different, often much shorter deadlines — sometimes as little as six months to file a formal claim. This is one of the biggest reasons to speak with an attorney quickly rather than waiting. Missing that window can end your claim before it starts.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and the independent attorneys in the network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. You're never obligated to move forward after speaking with an attorney.
